scope: Standalone real-source PhotoPolicy validation guards only
compile: real DomainException, PhotoUpload and PhotoPolicy; no framework stubs
harness_delivery: Ignored local harness and runner; not included in Git delivery

checks: First structural EOI must end the original codestream
APP payload marker-like bytes retain original bytes and hash
Real JDK baseline JPEG contains FF00 stuffing and RST0 and remains accepted
Real JDK progressive JPEG has multiple SOS and remains accepted
Invalid segment length/header/repeated SOI/restart position rejected
Synthetic TEM/DNL/fill input passes boundary scan but is rejected by full decoder validation
jpeg_boundary_regression.limits: Structural marker checks supplement mature ImageIO decoding; do not prove malware scanning or ImageIO support for synthetic DNL/TEM data

not_run: Controller/MinIO JUnit tests (33 new isolated API/adapters tests in total)
limitations: 56 standalone JDK assertions are not JUnit or component integration results
Structural codestream validation supplements mature ImageIO decoding; no malware scanning
TEM/DNL synthetic boundary checks do not establish decoder support for those inputs
Original bytes/hash preserved for accepted APP payload markers, real baseline stuffing/restart and progressive multi-SOS cases
All 128 contract TC remain NOT_RUN; photo business and M5-5/M8-6 remain PARTIAL

extension_boundary.rule: last dot must be after the first filename character and before the final filename character; extension must match original image type
